notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/878990/

Development is still in progress. I was hoping to release sooner, but my two initial prototypes and associated iterations haven't met my standards for engaging gameplay.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33093032/3495d6188972849fb34f847c5f7d81fa1526111f.png

At a minimum, I am currently drawing inspiration from Darkest Dungeon, mockumentaries, and the global financial crisis. The challenge is striking the right tone - dark, but not too dark. This is a game  more than an art-piece, and life is hard enough, right? :)

I highly value solid animation, thoughtful writing, and meaningful experiences. I will do my best to deliver all of these.

-rock
